Case Studies / Consultancy Management System

Consultancy Management
Case study · Professional services

Giving a consultancy's experts their time back, with AI built into the way the practice works.

Our client is a leading consultancy that helps people realise their housing plans. Its advisers are among the best in their field. We built the practice a single system to run its work, with AI support inside the application itself.

Sector
Professional services, housing advisory
Time to go live
75 days
Reported impact
75–80% less project-management effort
Platform
Python for building codes, JavaScript for the platform

The challenge

The firm's value lies in the judgement of its experts, yet much of their day was consumed by project management: tracking engagements, chasing tasks and deadlines, and keeping documents in order across separate tools. The expertise clients were paying for was being diluted by the administration around it.

On top of that, much of the work involves checking against complex building codes — exactly the kind of structured, repetitive analysis that software should support rather than leave to manual effort on every project.

The approach

We started by mapping how the practice actually runs an engagement, from the first client conversation to the final deliverable, and built the system around that flow rather than adapting a generic template. We then identified where AI could genuinely support the adviser's judgement and placed it inside the workflow, not in a separate tool.

The solution: one workspace for the practice

  1. Client
  2. Engagement
  3. Tasks & deadlines
  4. Building-code checks
  5. Documents
  6. Delivery
  • One record per client — every engagement, task and document in one place, so a partner can see where each piece of work stands.
  • Clear ownership — tasks and deadlines are visible to the people responsible for them.
  • AI built into the application — used where it supports the adviser, as part of the everyday workflow.
  • The right tool for each job — complex building-code logic implemented in Python, with the rest of the platform in JavaScript.

The outcome

The system went live in 75 days. The founder reports a 75–80% reduction in project-management effort, returning that time to client work.

  • More time for advice — experts spend their days on the work clients value.
  • Visibility across the practice — the status of every engagement is clear without chasing.
  • Faster access to information — client details and documents are no longer scattered across tools.
  • AI that fits the work — no separate product for the team to learn.

What it demonstrates

  • Mapping a professional-services workflow before writing software
  • Practical, embedded AI rather than AI as a bolt-on
  • Choosing the technology for each problem — Python where the domain logic demands it
  • Measurable operational impact within a single quarter
